name: Honbridge Holdings Limited
summary: Honbridge Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research, production, and sale of lithium-ion batteries in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Mineral Resources Exploration and Trading; Lithium Battery Production; and Trading of Mineral Resources segments. The company also researches and explores mineral resources; trades in minerals; and provides platform, riding, motor vehicle rental, advertising and related services, and battery testing services. In addition, the company engages in iron ore projects in Brazil and sales of bauxite. Honbridge Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
